pairwise.observed_pixel_difference: The first uses heavy stone-like blocks descending into a tray. The second uses flat fine-line ribbons folding into a comb.
The first stacks charcoal evidence enclosures along a diagonal. The other fans out cut-paper samples and arcs around an isolated tray.
The first spreads three asymmetric enclosures across a tabletop. The latter stays level in side elevation with one long rotating-looking throat and three output branches.
The first shows a court docket across an angled evidence bench. The latter stacks two review destinations to the right of a single folio.
The first steps down to one receiving court tray. The latter joins four accountability instruments around a diamond with a reverse green connection.
The weave links repeated flat tool threads through the center. The paper specimen comparison travels under the center and avoids its vendor tray.
The line-art weave converges from looped strands into a selection comb. The etched side elevation splits a cache-fed tunnel into three office branches.
The blue-green braid terminates at one selection surface. The pencil composition instead uses a left record folio and two staggered review surfaces.
The mint stencil uses three adjacent sequential routing clusters. The mulberry woodcut encloses four different instruments in one open diamond.
The amber specimens and trial ring are connected by a bypass arc. The teal cache machine remains level in profile and expands through a right-hand fan.
The cut-paper fan brackets a center vendor sample with a curved bypass. The cyan folio sits adjacent to two stacked review surfaces.
The sample fan sits outside a freestanding workload ring, leaving the center tray isolated. The governance image gathers all four lenses inside one open diamond.
The cache artwork is a methodical horizontal industrial cutaway. The chart-free healthcare image reads diagonally to a draft over a second review location.
The machine advances from cache through a horizontal tunnel to office objects. The inspection apparatus instead surrounds empty center space and routes from right to left.
The blue folio and trays form a staggered handoff. The magenta and green image holds symmetric inspection pairs around one opening.
